fee_notes: Royalty is tiered: 7% of Gross Sales from Core Business and 3% of Gross Sales from Related Business. A negotiated Minimum Annual Royalty applies; shortfall payable within 30 days after each Minimum Annual Royalty Year. An Additional Royalty of 0%–3% of total gross sales applies only if franchisee defers part of initial franchise fee (Note 2). National Advertising Fee is up to 4% of monthly Gross Sales (Core + Related); counts toward the 10% total annual Advertising Expenditure Requirement rather than being additive. Cooperative advertising fee ranges approximately 4%–12% of annual aggregate gross sales in media areas where franchisor has controlling voting power. Technology Fee for Required Components is currently $0 but may be implemented up to a cap of 4% of annual Gross Sales (aggregate ceiling); annual increases capped at lesser of CPI + 3% or actual cost increases; 180 days' written notice required before implementing new fees or increasing existing fees by more than 10%. Call Routing Infrastructure fees: estimated $0.06–$0.09 per minute (billed monthly). National Customer Contact Center fees: $0.95–$1.05 per minute, voluntary. Additional Training Tuition: $200–$650 per person per session. Transfer Fee: $10,000. Renewal Fee: $10,000. Audit Fee: estimated $4,000–$8,000.
raw_excerpt:
Monthly Royalty: Monthly royalty payment equal to seven percent (7%) of Gross Sales from Core Business and three percent (3%) of Gross Sales from Related Business. Payable monthly on the fifteenth (15th) day of the next month, by electronic funds transfer if required by us.
Minimum Annual Royalty: If the total of monthly royalty payments paid by you during a Minimum Annual Royalty Year does not meet the Minimum Annual Royalty you owe, you must pay us the difference. Payable within thirty (30) days following the end of each Minimum Annual Royalty Year.
Additional Royalty: Zero (0) to three percent (3%) of total gross sales. Payable monthly on the 15th day of the next month.
Late Payment Fee: The lesser of eighteen percent (18%) per annum (the "Default Rate") or the maximum rate permitted under applicable law, on all amounts not paid when payment is due. When payment is overdue.
Advertising Expenditure Requirement: Not less than ten percent (10%) of annual Gross Sales, allocated to qualifying Advertising Expenditures. Payable as incurred, but total amount must be spent within the calendar year.
National Advertising Fee: Up to four percent (4%) of monthly Gross Sales from Core Business and Related Business. Any increase in the fee percentage requires ninety (90) days' prior written notice. Payable monthly on the 15th day of the following month.
Advertising Expenditure Shortfall Payment: If you fail to meet the Advertising Expenditure Requirement and do not cure the shortfall within the Catch-Up Period, the shortfall amount will be payable to the national advertising fund.
1-800-STEEMER® & Call Routing Infrastructure Fees: Actual cost of usage on a per minute basis for all customer calls. We estimate current cost to be between $0.06 and $0.09 per minute. Thirty (30) days after billing.
National Customer Contact Center Usage Fees: Actual cost of usage on a per minute basis. We estimate current cost to be $0.95 to $1.05 per minute. Participation is voluntary. Thirty (30) days after billing.
Additional Training Tuition Fee: $200-$650 per person for each training session. Thirty (30) days after billing.
Transfer Fee: $10,000. Before transfer is effective.
Renewal Fee: $10,000. Upon execution of renewal agreements.
Audit Fee: Actual cost of any audit, plus late payment fee. We estimate the actual cost of an audit to range between $4,000 to $8,000. Immediately upon billing.
Training Fee Related to Integrated Technology Systems: Up to $250. Immediately upon billing.
Technology Fee: Required Components: Currently $0. We reserve the right to implement Technology Fees for Required Components of our Integrated Technology Systems. If implemented, total Required Component Technology Fees may not exceed four percent (4%) of your annual Gross Sales solely as the measurement benchmark for calculating the Aggregate Ceiling. Annual fee increases are capped at the lesser of CPI + three percent (3%) or actual cost increases.
Technology Fee: Elective Components: Varies. If you elect to use optional technology tools or features beyond the Required Components, you will pay usage-based or subscription-based fees.
